chunks: Abu Ali Al-Ash'ari, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali Al-Kufi, from Al-Abbas ibn Amir, from Al-Rabi' ibn Muhammad Al-Musli, from Abu Al-Rabi' Al-Shami, who said:

I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) saying: 'Indeed, when our Qaim rises, Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, will extend for our Shias in their hearing and their vision, so that there will not be a postman (distance/time of a courier) between them and the Qaim; they will speak to him, hear him, and look at him, while he is in his place.'

key_terms.بَرِيدٌ: Postman/Courier (metaphor for distance or time delay)
key_terms.عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ: The Mighty and Majestic (attribute of Allah)

ai.seo_question: What sensory enhancements will the Shia receive during the rise of the Qaim?
ai.summary: This narration from al-Kafi highlights the miraculous proximity (qurb) of the Shia to Imam al-Mahdi during his occultation or rise, emphasizing that the barrier of physical distance is removed through divine enhancement of their hearing and sight. Scholarly tradition interprets this 'barid' (courier/distance) not merely as physical speed but as a spiritual and sensory immediacy, reinforcing the concept of the Imam's continuous presence despite his physical absence. This serves as a key proof for the Shia belief in the Imam's ability to communicate directly with his followers across vast distances.

en.hubeali: H 14777 – Abu Ali Al-Ashary, from Al-Hassan Bin Ali Al-kufy, from Al-Abbas Bin Aamir, from Al-Rabi’e Bin Muhammad Al-Muslyy, from Abu Al-Rabi’e who said:

I heard Abu Abdullahasws saying that: ‘When our Qaimasws makes a stand, Allahazwj will extend the hearing of ourasws Shites, and their vision to the extent that there will not be a postman in between them and Al-Qaimasws. They will be speaking, and hearing, and visualising himasws and heasws would be in Mecca’.
en.sarwar: 330. Abu Ali Al-Ashary, from Al-Hassan Bin Ali Al-kufy, from Al-Abbas Bin Aamir, from Al-Rabi’e Bin Muhammad Al-Muslyy, from Abu Al-Rabi’e who said:

I heard Abu Abdullah (a.s.) saying that: ‘When our Qaim (a.s.) makes a stand, Allah (azwj) will extend the hearing of our (a.s.) Shites, and their vision to the extent that there will not be a postman in between them and Al-Qaim (a.s.). They will be speaking, and hearing, and visualising him (a.s.) and he (a.s.) would be in Mecca’.
